    • SliceResult

      private SliceResult(String id, String name, String provenance, String candidateEvaluatorId, String[] axisActionIds, ProcessModelOperatingAction.ValueSemantics[] axisActionSemantics, double[][] axisValues, double[] anchorValues, int requestedPointCount, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.Outcome outcome, List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.Point> points, List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.Transition> transitions, List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionTransition> operatingRegionTransitions, List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionBoundaryRefinement> boundaryRefinements, List<String> diagnostics, int evaluationCount, double runtimeSeconds, int maximumBoundaryRefinementEvaluations, double boundaryRefinementRelativeTolerance, String boundaryRefinementToleranceProvenance, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy sourceStudy)
      Creates an immutable result.
      Parameters:
      id - study identifier
      name - study name
      provenance - study provenance
      candidateEvaluatorId - evaluator identifier
      axisActionIds - axis action identifiers
      axisActionSemantics - axis action value semantics
      axisValues - requested grids
      anchorValues - complete anchor vector
      requestedPointCount - requested point count
      outcome - terminal outcome
      points - completed points
      transitions - sampled transitions
      operatingRegionTransitions - sampled feasibility/outcome/evidence transitions
      boundaryRefinements - fail-closed continuous feasibility-boundary receipts
      diagnostics - study diagnostics
      evaluationCount - simulator evaluations used by this slice
      runtimeSeconds - measured wall-clock runtime
      maximumBoundaryRefinementEvaluations - maximum midpoint evaluations per eligible transition
      boundaryRefinementRelativeTolerance - terminal bracket tolerance relative to the action range
      boundaryRefinementToleranceProvenance - engineering source of the tolerance
      sourceStudy - exact runtime study that produced this result

    • getSampledCells

      public List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.SampledCell> getSampledCells()
      Returns exact sampled-cell topology for a complete two-dimensional slice.

      Corner order is clockwise from the lower grid coordinate: lower/lower, lower/upper, upper/upper, upper/lower. One-dimensional or incomplete slices return an empty list. Discrete axes remain sampled categories and are never interpolated.

      Returns:
      fresh immutable sampled-cell list in row-major order

    • toEvidenceMap

      public Map<String,Object> toEvidenceMap()
      Converts this slice to a compact machine-readable evidence map.

      Non-finite numerical evidence is represented as null so the returned structure can be encoded as strict JSON. The complete immutable Java result remains available through the typed getters.

      Returns:
      deeply immutable JSON-friendly evidence map
